thread:
michelle: Ran into another onboarding hiccup: demo app in json-mode + fncall returns arrays of objects but the JS SDK sanitizer turned them into strings, so zod validation fails.

raj: can you paste the raw model output and what the sdk passed to the validator? even a tiny example helps.

michelle: sure. raw from model (jsonMode enabled):
```json
{"results":[{"user":"jane","score":95},{"user":"lee","score":88}]}
```
what arrived at the validator: 
```json
{"results":["{\"user\":\"jane\",\"score\":95}","{\"user\":\"lee\",\"score\":88}"]}
```

dom: hmm. that's double-stringification inside arrays. Which SDK version?

michelle: js-sdk 0.10.2, running the fncall helper path (tool-runner). Python sample app didn't hit this.

raj: quick theory: sanitizeForJson probably normalizes primitives and stringifies unknowns, but assumes arrays are primitives only. When array members are objects, it stringifies them instead of preserving them.

michelle: repro steps posted in the sample-app repo: github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/issue-331-array-object-sanitize (minimal repro).

dom: parsing heuristics are dangerous. We had false positives before when model text contained JSON-like fragments inside normal prose.

michelle: Agreed. I think pragmatic solution for onboarding: add an explicit opt-in flag SANITIZE_PARSE_STRINGS_IN_ARRAYS that tells the sanitizer to attempt JSON.parse on array member strings if they look like JSON (starts with { or [). Default is off. Enable it in the demo env for now.

raj: fine as a stopgap. Long-term I'd rather detect that the response was generated as structured JSON (we already have jsonMode) and prefer not to do heuristic parsing, but to add a small helper that can try parsing when user opts in. Also add a safety threshold: only parse strings shorter than, say, 10k chars, and only when parse succeeds and the result is object/array.

michelle: implemented a tiny patch in my branch that exposes SANITIZE_PARSE_STRINGS_IN_ARRAYS and adds tests for mixed arrays (number, string, object-string). Draft PR: github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/520

cli-bot: CI started for commit aa7c... (job 6142)

dom: please add telemetry: increment "sanitizer.array_parse_attempt" with outcome "success"/"fail" and include sdk_version and json_mode boolean. We need to see how often this helps vs causes extra parsing of non-json text.

raj: +1. Also add a unit test ensuring top-level stringified-object remains string (we shouldn't auto-parse top-level to avoid breaking existing uses where text is intentionally a string).

michelle: added telemetry and the extra test. CI passed on my branch. eng-bot reports: all tests green :white_check_mark:.

dom: ok to merge this as a minor patch with docs note in the onboarding README explaining the env var and tradeoffs. We'll revisit making it default only after analyzing telemetry for 2 weeks.

michelle: updated onboarding README and sample env in the demo repo. added a short code snippet for enabling the flag in docker-compose.

raj: tiny nit: in the PR description, call out that this only triggers for elements that are strings and look like JSON (regex ^\s*[\{\[]) and that we limit parse size. Helps reviewers know it's constrained.

michelle: done. Thanks all. Follow-up: issue #332 created to track whether to flip default after telemetry.

eng-bot: PR 520 merged into main and release build queued (release/0.10.3).

michelle: closing thread. :party-parrot:
